jobs.title: دستگاه حکاکی لیزر فایبر رومیزی
jobs.ref: LEFTMOST column upright, title حکاکی لیزر فایبر رومیزی. Actual product: low elongated rectangular silver/gray desktop base, dark burgundy/brown long side panel, blue/dark short front control fascia with switches and red emergency stop. Single tall aluminum vertical Z column mounted at rear of base, horizontal silver galvo marking head projecting over base working area, black cable looping from head down to base. No separate computer monitor, no full desk or enclosed cabinet. Preserve proportions/visible colors from photo and thumbnail.
jobs.prompt: Create ONE high-resolution landscape 3:2 Sahand Laser dimensional product sheet. Input1 is approved catalog sheet template: copy ONLY its page layout, navy/pale-blue/white palette and RED Persian-English Sahand Laser logo. Input2 is actual marking machine catalog page, photographed SIDEWAYS; mentally rotate to read upright. Use ONLY this specific column for product identity: LEFTMOST column upright, title حکاکی لیزر فایبر رومیزی. Actual product: low elongated rectangular silver/gray desktop base, dark burgundy/brown long side panel, blue/dark short front control fascia with switches and red emergency stop. Single tall aluminum vertical Z column mounted at rear of base, horizontal silver galvo marking head projecting over base working area, black cable looping from head down to base. No separate computer monitor, no full desk or enclosed cabinet. Preserve proportions/visible colors from photo and thumbnail. Upper left large faithful elevated three-quarter product render, clean white/light-blue backdrop, preserve actual product exterior and arrangement. Top-left red سهند لیزر / SAHAND LASER logo. Right navy header 'DESKTOP MARKER' then 'دستگاه حکاکی لیزر فایبر رومیزی' then 'Desktop Fiber Laser Marker'. Right blue panel 'ابعاد کلی دستگاه'/'Overall Dimensions', 'L × W × H', '600 × 300 × 850 mm'. Values are from user-supplied catalog cm converted to mm, not invented. Under panel small blue isometric line drawing of same machine with dimension arrows length600mm(L), width300mm(W), height850mm(H). Bottom three schematic orthographic top/side/front views coherent with main machine and reference thumbnail: top L600/W300, side L600/H850, front W300/H850. Bilingual captions 'نمای بالا / Top View', 'نمای جانبی / Side View', 'نمای جلو / Front View'. Blue measurement lines/numbers, white technical area, thin blue rounded outer border, navy section tab. Footer 'ابعاد بر اساس کاتالوگ سهند لیزر | نماها شماتیک هستند' and 'Unit: mm'. Preserve column positions, galvo head, cable routing and distinct model shape. Do not mix columns, add internals or substitute a welder/cutter. No additional equipment or unsupported specifications. Crisp exact Persian and numerals, professional catalog finish. These are schematic catalog illustrations, not CAD manufacturing drawings.
